Nogometni klub Krško Posavje, commonly referred to as NK Krško Posavje or simply Krško Posavje, is a Slovenian football club from Krško that competes in the Slovenian Second League, the second tier of Slovenian football. The club was founded in 1922. Their home ground is the Matija Gubec Stadium with a capacity to accommodate 1,470 spectators.
